d:
T-Series present Remix of Loveyatri first video song "CHOGADA", The movie features Aayush Sharma and Warina Hussain in leading roles. Loveyatri is an upcoming Bollywood movie produced by Salman Khan's Salman Khan Films and directed by Abhiraj Minawala. This Latest Hindi Video Song of 2018 is in the voice of " Darshan Raval& Asees Kaur", composed by " Lijo George - Dj Chetas" and the lyrics of this new song are penned by "Darshan Raval". The song is Remix by Tanishk Bagchi.
Song - Chogada
Singer - Darshan Raval, Asees Kaur
Remix - Tanishk Bagchi
Lyrics - Darshan Raval
